assessment_help_aoutement: Hardening describes how this year's shoots firm up as they turn from soft green growth into wood. A well-hardened tree has often finished its aerial flush and can cope better with a late-season lift. Shoots that are still green and tender point to a higher risk.
assessment_help_bark: Bark appearance hints at maturity. Smooth bark often suggests a younger tree; flaky or deeply furrowed bark usually points to more age and character.
assessment_help_caliber: Caliber is a quick estimate of trunk thickness, using your hand or a familiar object as a reference. It helps you judge the tree's presence at a glance without precise measurement.
assessment_help_cernage: Root pruning status shows whether roots have already been cut around the tree to prepare a future lift. Advanced pruning can make recovery easier; pruning that is too recent or complete just before extraction can weaken the tree instead.
assessment_help_deadwood: Note any natural deadwood already present—dry branches, trunk veins, or hollows. These marks of time are part of the tree's character and are worth recording in the field.
assessment_help_leaf_fall: Estimate how much of the foliage has already fallen naturally. While nearly all leaves are still on the tree (0 %), it has not finished sending reserves back into the roots. Around 80 to 100 % leaf fall, that transfer is usually well advanced, which is more favorable for an autumn lift.
assessment_help_nebari: Nebari describes the visible root base and how the tree sits in the ground. A flat, radiating flare is often the most attractive; a one-sided or rock-wedged base can still work, but it tells a different design story.
assessment_help_phenology_stage: Record the tree's actual stage in the field. This refines the YRS score beyond the weather-based estimate alone. The spring collection window is short: it opens mainly around bud swell and bud break, then closes once the leaves expand. On pines, candle elongation is the right moment; the brush stage means the window is closing.
assessment_help_potential: Give a subjective score from 1 to 10 for how interesting the tree is to you—shape, movement, base, and presence. This is not a scientific score, only your field judgment.
assessment_help_size: Size class places the tree in a familiar format—small, medium, or large—based on its approximate height once imagined in cultivation.
assessment_help_trunk_diameter: If you can, enter the trunk diameter in centimeters. It is a simple measurement that complements the estimated caliber.

gdd_7d_level_low_text: cool period or temporary slowdown in plant activity.
gdd_7d_warning: 7-day GDD is a trend indicator only. Do not use it alone to decide collection. Soil temperature, local weather and direct bud observation remain most reliable.
gdd_7d_yamadori_intro: 7-day GDD helps detect recent climate changes:
gdd_7d_yamadori_point_1: Favorable cumulative GDD with high 7-day GDD suggests increasingly favorable root activity and bud break.
gdd_7d_yamadori_point_2: Low 7-day GDD may indicate stagnation despite an advanced spring.

gdd_help_text: Growing degree days (GDD) measure heat accumulated since January 1. Each day, mean temperature above a base threshold (adapted to species or biotope) is summed. The seasonal zone indicates the yamadori window (150–400 °d). The transition label summarizes phenology — use it as a guide, not certainty.

privacy_data_cadastre_body: Cached locally. Coordinates sent to national cadastre / protected-area services when enabled. Not shared. Deletion: Settings → clear cadastre cache.
privacy_data_location_body: Stored on device (trees, parking, position). Sent online: latitude/longitude only, to enabled APIs. Shareable via export or tree sharing. Deletion: delete the tree or clear caches in Settings.
privacy_data_map_body: Cached locally. Tile requests for the visible map area by country (IGN, CNIG, basemap.de, OS…). Not shared. Deletion: Settings → clear map cache.
privacy_data_photos_body: Stored on device. Never sent online by Yamadori. Shareable via export or tree sharing. Deletion: delete the tree.
privacy_data_voice_body: Stored on device. Never sent online. Shareable via backup export only. Deletion: delete the tree.
privacy_data_weather_body: Cached locally after a request. Coordinates sent to Open-Meteo when that API is enabled. Not shared. Deletion: Settings → clear weather cache.
privacy_intro: Yamadori does not sync your scouting entries to the cloud. Your field notebook lives in your pocket.
privacy_inventory_intro: What Yamadori handles for your field notebook — where it is stored, what goes online and how to delete it.
privacy_pillar_api_controls_body: Each network connection can be disabled individually in Settings. If you turn off an API, no more live requests; already downloaded cache remains available offline.
privacy_pillar_backup_body: Export a backup regularly (USB drive, personal cloud). Without an export password, the file guarantees integrity only (checksums), not confidentiality: anyone who has the file can extract the data. With a password, the entire archive is encrypted (PBKDF2 + AES-GCM). The hint is a memory aid only; it cannot recover the password.
privacy_pillar_gps_body: In the foreground, GPS is used to scout a tree, display the map and contextualise weather. Tracking stops when the app is in the background. No location is sent to a Yamadori server.
privacy_pillar_honest_body: Like a paper notebook in your bag, your scouting entries remain readable on an unlocked device. Yamadori does not use Android’s automatic backup to Google. We recommend a screen lock and password-protected exports.
privacy_pillar_local_body: No account, no Yamadori server. Your scouting entries, photos, voice notes and starting point stay on this device. By default, data is stored unencrypted in local storage; you can enable local encryption in Settings (optional, Android) — it protects trees, parking, the export password and GPS settings, but not weather or map caches.
privacy_pillar_network_body: When online, only your GPS coordinates are sent to public services for weather, agronomy, maps, cadastre, protected areas and geocoding — never your photos or notes. By country: Open-Meteo, IGN / CNIG / basemap.de / OS / swisstopo / basemap.at / OpenTopo (BE, SE, JP, AU, DK, FI, IE, CA, NZ) / PDOK BRT (NL) / Kartverket (NO) / USGS (US), EEA, Natural England, FOEN, CadGIS, Nominatim (OpenStreetMap), and others.
privacy_pillar_no_tracking_body: No Yamadori account, no ads, no analytics (Firebase, crash reporters, etc.). No data resale. No third-party cookies: the app runs locally in an Android WebView.
privacy_pillar_offline_body: Map, weather and cadastre data are cached locally. GPS works without a network — even deep in the woods.
privacy_pillar_permissions_body: Camera: tree photos only, when you tap Capture. Microphone: voice notes (30 s max), on your action. Location: scouting, map and weather, only while the app is in the foreground. Compass: heading display during capture, processed locally. The permissions wizard on first launch guides you — nothing is requested without reason.
privacy_pillar_share_body: Sharing a tree or exporting a backup is entirely your choice. Nothing is sent to third parties automatically.
privacy_pillar_share_title: You decide who sees your spots
privacy_pillar_third_parties_body: Open-Meteo (forecasts and climate history; commercial use under the publisher’s subscription), national maps (IGN FR, CNIG ES, basemap.de, Ordnance Survey / OSM fallback, swisstopo CH, basemap.at AT, OpenTopo BE/SE/JP/AU/DK/FI/IE/CA/NZ, PDOK BRT NL, Kartverket NO, USGS US), cadastre (IGN Apicarto, Catastro ES, Catasto IT, partial ALKIS DE, HMLR GB, AV/EGRID CH + ZH AVWFS, AT municipality, CadGIS BE, BRK NL, kommun SE, matrikkel NO, DGT PT, Nominatim DK/FI/IE/JP, CAPAD AU, PAD-US, CPCAD CA, DOC NZ), protected areas (IGN FR, EEA, Natural England, FOEN/Pro Natura CH, CAPAD AU, MOE/KSJ A10 JP, PAD-US, CPCAD CA, DOC NZ), Nominatim/OpenStreetMap (place labels), municipal directories by country. Yamadori has no intermediary server: your coordinates go directly to these public services, each with its own privacy policy. Your photos and notes never leave the device this way.

settings_backup_hint: Full backup of your data. Without a password, the file is readable outside Yamadori. Check “Protect archive” to encrypt it.
settings_backup_import_hint: Merge adds to your existing data. Replace all deletes your entire current backup in favor of the one you import.
settings_backup_password_hint: The password encrypts the entire exported file. It is not stored on the device — you will enter it on each export. If you forget it, the backup cannot be recovered.
settings_backup_password_hint_help: The hint helps you remember; it cannot recover the password.
settings_backup_password_recommended: Recommended: set an export password to make shared backups confidential.
settings_backup_password_reset_message: The configuration will be cleared on this device. Already exported backups remain protected by the old password.
settings_backup_password_reset_with_hint: Hint: {hint} — The configuration will be cleared on this device. Already exported backups remain protected by the old password.
settings_backup_password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
settings_backup_password_unavailable: Password unavailable on this device — set it up again in settings.
settings_cadastre_offline_hint: Cadastral parcel lookups are cached for 30 days to show land ownership hints offline.
settings_compass_gps_hint: GPS update frequency while navigating to a tree or parking spot. Map heading lock always uses the navigation profile.
settings_compass_gps_proximity_hint: Less frequent updates (~5–15 s). Useful if the compass stays open for a long time.
settings_compass_gps_watch_hint: Distance updated every ~2–5 s. Good balance of accuracy and battery.
settings_dark_hint: Pure black background to save battery on OLED screens.
settings_export_share_canceled: Share canceled — backup was not sent.
settings_export_too_large: Backup too large ({sizeMo} MB). Remove photos or export fewer trees.
settings_legacy_archive_reexport_body: Archives without a password or with the legacy key format are not confidential. Select a .yamadori.zip file to re-export it with a password.
settings_legacy_archive_reexport_passwor: Choose a password to encrypt the re-exported archive.
settings_loading_wait: Data still loading — try again in a moment.
settings_local_encryption_confirm_body: Your trees, photos and sensitive settings will be encrypted on this device. Slight performance impact possible. Without a recent export, uninstalling will make data unreadable.
settings_local_encryption_hint: Recommended. Protects your notebook against direct device storage access (transparent, no unlock each launch).
settings_local_encryption_migration_fail: Encryption change failed. Please try again.
settings_local_encryption_migration_time: Migration took too long. Try again with fewer trees or photos.
settings_local_encryption_migration_wait: Please wait and keep the app open — encryption is in progress.
settings_local_encryption_off_warning: Off: data remains readable on this device.
settings_offline_map_hint: On the map, tap Offline, then pinch and drag to position the zone under the centered green square.
settings_offline_storage_hint: Data cached locally so you can view map, weather and cadastre without a connection.
settings_offline_tip_1: Topographic and satellite maps downloaded together
settings_offline_tip_2: Two zoom levels around current view
settings_offline_tip_3: Kept about 30 days · up to 10,000 tiles
settings_onboarding_reset: Permissions wizard reset — restart the app.
settings_online_services_hint: Choose which services receive your approximate location (~1 km for weather and geocoding). Cached data stays available offline even when a service is disabled.
settings_outdoor_android_brightness: On the Android app, screen brightness goes to maximum.
settings_outdoor_hint: White background, black text, thick borders and bold fonts.
settings_power_saving_hint: Reduces GPS update frequency and enables dark mode.
settings_power_saving_outdoor_blocked: Turn off power saving first to enable bright sun mode.
settings_privacy_hint: Where your scouting data goes, what stays on your device, and what goes online.
settings_replace_message: Local trees and parking will be replaced by the backup. This action is irreversible.
settings_simple_mode_hint: Hides analysis panels (YRS, climate, cadastre…) for a more direct scouting flow.
settings_storage_locked: Migration in progress — please try again in a moment.
settings_terrain_mode_hint: Physical shortcuts for hands-free scouting. Volume Down = voice note, Volume Up = photo then save.
settings_weather_offline_hint: Open-Meteo forecasts are cached to power YRS score offline, within about 30 km.

species_protection_check_blocked: Confirmation blocked: this species is flagged as protected. Check the official source — taking it may be an offence even with the landowner’s consent.
species_protection_pack_partial: Limited species pack for this country — no alert does not mean the species is unrestricted. Always check the official source.
store_local_encryption_key_missing: Local encryption is on but the key is missing — import a recent backup from Settings.
store_local_encryption_key_missing_help: The device's security key was lost (reset or data cleanup). Only a backup exported before this problem can restore your scouting data.
store_trees_corrupt: Local data unreadable — try a backup or reinstall the app.
store_trees_migration_wait: Please wait and keep the app open — your trees and photos are being reorganized.
tree_delete_message: This action is irreversible. The tree and its photo will be permanently deleted.

tutorial_capture_step_cadastre: Check land status — any collection requires the owner's permission.
tutorial_capture_step_gps: Wait for the position to settle, phone in hand near the trunk.
tutorial_capture_step_photo: Photograph the tree — it's your main field record.
tutorial_capture_step_save: When you're ready, save your first scouting entry.
tutorial_capture_step_species: Enter the species if you know it — otherwise you can skip.
tutorial_capture_step_voice: Tap to dictate a quick note without typing.
tutorial_capture_step_yrs: The YRS score estimates whether conditions (soil, climate) favor collection.
us_harvest_calendar_none: No curated calendar for this species / region.
veto_automatic_block: Collection forbidden — absolute protection zone detected.
veto_check_disclaimer: I have read this clause and understand that information is provided for guidance only, without liability on the part of the publisher.
veto_check_property: I certify that I hold written, signed authorization from the owner of this parcel (private owner, town hall, or ONF agreement).
veto_check_property_forbidden: I acknowledge that this land type is generally forbidden or strictly regulated, and that I checked with the competent authority — indicative only.
veto_check_property_owner: I certify that I obtained written authorization from the owner (private party, municipality or land manager) for this parcel — indicative only, not legal validation.
veto_check_property_permit: I certify that I started or obtained the required permit process with the competent authority or agency — indicative only.
veto_check_protected_area: I certify that the parcel is not in a regulated protected area.
veto_check_restoration: I commit to filling the extraction hole with original soil and restoring the ground to its initial appearance.
veto_check_species: I certify that I checked INPN and this species is not among protected plant species (national and regional orders).
veto_check_species_caution: I certify that I verified the official source despite the alert, and that collecting this species is permitted here.
veto_disclaimer_body: Protected zoning, cadastral data, legal references and external links shown in this app are provided for information only. They do not constitute legal advice, collection permission or a guarantee of accuracy. The Yamadori publisher cannot be held liable for any error, omission, outdated source data or interpretation. You remain solely responsible for checking applicable regulations with the competent authorities before any collection.
veto_disclaimer_country_note: Context: {country}. Texts and links are indicative for this country; local rules (municipality, canton, state, province) may differ.
veto_disclaimer_note_at: Austria: species and forest rules are largely Land-level. RIS and the biodiversity atlas are indicative.
veto_disclaimer_note_au: Australia: DCCEEW / Parks Australia / state agencies depending on tenure. No link authorizes collection.
veto_disclaimer_note_be: Belgium: regional competence (Wallonia, Flanders, Brussels). Check the authority for the relevant region.
veto_disclaimer_note_ca: Canada: Parks Canada / ECCC / provincial or territorial Crown depending on tenure. No link authorizes collection.
veto_disclaimer_note_ch: Switzerland: forests and nature are mainly cantonal (FOEN / cantonal services). Cadastre.ch does not grant authorization.
veto_disclaimer_note_de: Germany: forest and nature-protection law is mainly Land-level. Check the relevant Land forestry / nature authority.
veto_disclaimer_note_dk: Denmark: Naturstyrelsen / Miljøstyrelsen and municipalities. No link authorizes collection.
veto_disclaimer_note_es: Spain: competence is largely regional (autonomous communities). MITECO and the national cadastre do not authorize collection.
veto_disclaimer_note_fi: Finland: Metsähallitus / municipalities. Jokaisenoikeudet ≠ digging up trees. No link authorizes collection.
veto_disclaimer_note_fr: France: competence is often municipal (mairie) and, in public forest, ONF / local authority. National texts do not replace local rules.
veto_disclaimer_note_gb: United Kingdom: competence by nation (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland). Listed hubs are starting points only.
veto_disclaimer_note_ie: Ireland: NPWS / Coillte and local authorities. No link authorizes collection.
veto_disclaimer_note_it: Italy: national frameworks (Normattiva) plus regional / local rules. Species portals and MASE are indicative.
veto_disclaimer_note_jp: Japan: MOE / Forestry Agency / prefectures depending on land and species. No link authorizes collection. Pack pending human legal review.
veto_disclaimer_note_nl: Netherlands: nature permits often via RVO / land manager (e.g. Staatsbosbeheer). Links are starting points only.
veto_disclaimer_note_no: Norway: Miljødirektoratet / Landbruksdirektoratet and Statsforvalteren. Indicative only.
veto_disclaimer_note_nz: New Zealand: DOC / councils / Whenua Rahui depending on tenure. No link authorizes collection.
veto_disclaimer_note_pt: Portugal: ICNF / DGT and local authorities. No link authorizes collection.
veto_disclaimer_note_se: Sweden: Skogsstyrelsen / Naturvårdsverket and Länsstyrelsen. Indicative only.
veto_disclaimer_note_us: United States: USFS / BLM / NPS / state agencies depending on tenure. No link authorizes collection.
veto_guidance_forbidden: Indicative: collection is generally forbidden on this land type. Check with the competent authority — not legal advice.
veto_guidance_forbidden_or_agency: Indicative: forbidden or strictly agency-controlled. Contact the manager before any collection.
veto_guidance_owner_permission: Indicative: private or similar land — owner permission (via town hall / registry / manager) is essential.
veto_guidance_owner_permission_au: Indicative: CAPAD does not map private parcels. Find your local council (ALGA), confirm tenure, request written owner permission, keep proof, and do not enter without consent.
veto_guidance_owner_permission_be: Indicative: identify the parcel via CadGIS / the cadastre, then contact the owner or commune in writing for permission. A nature ordinance is not an authorisation to collect.
veto_guidance_owner_permission_ca: Indicative: CPCAD does not map all Crown or private land. Verify tenure with the province; if private, contact the municipality / owner in writing, keep proof, and do not enter without consent.
veto_guidance_owner_permission_gb: Indicative: find your local council and the land register (HM Land Registry / Registers of Scotland / Land Registry NI), request written owner permission, keep proof, and do not enter without consent.
veto_guidance_owner_permission_jp: Indicative: no free national parcel cadastre in-app. Identify the owner via 登記情報提供サービス (registry) or your municipality, request written permission, keep proof, and do not enter without consent.
veto_guidance_owner_permission_us: Indicative: PAD-US does not map private parcels. Identify the owner via the county assessor / tax parcel map, request written permission, keep proof, and do not enter without consent.
veto_guidance_permit_required: Indicative: a permit or agency authorization is usually required. Use the links below to start the process.
veto_guidance_unknown: Indicative: ambiguous tenure. Do not assume private or open — verify with local authorities.
veto_guidance_unknown_au: Indicative: outside CAPAD — may be Crown or private. Check CAPAD, then your local council / land titles; never assume collection is allowed.
veto_guidance_unknown_ca: Indicative: outside CPCAD — may be Crown or private. Verify with the province; if private, use your municipality to reach the owner. Never assume collection is allowed.
veto_guidance_unknown_jp: Indicative: tenure unverified. Use the land registry (登記) or municipality to identify the owner/manager; park/species rules may still apply. Never assume collection is allowed.
veto_law_cc547_text: "The natural or industrial fruits of the land [...] belong to the owner by right of accession."
veto_law_cc552_text: "Ownership of the land carries ownership of what is above and below it." This includes trees, shrubs, and the soil/substrate taken with the root ball.
veto_law_ce_l411_1_text: Prohibits "destruction, cutting, mutilation, uprooting, picking or removal" of protected plant species — even with the landowner's consent.
veto_law_ce_l415_3_text: Criminal provisions: harming protected plant species — offence punishable by 3 years' imprisonment and €150,000 fine.
veto_law_cf_l161_1_text: Punishes degradation of forest soils or tracks — hence the obligation to fill the hole and restore the ground.
veto_law_cf_l331_2_text: Severely punishes unauthorized uprooting or cutting. Fines are based on volume or tree count; equipment used (vehicle, shovels, picks) may be confiscated.
veto_law_cp311_1_text: "Theft is the fraudulent taking of another's property." Removing a tree without the owner's explicit consent (public or private) is legally theft.
veto_law_generic_text: Indicative summary — check the official text via the link. This is not legal advice.
veto_law_jp_designated_plants_text: Alpine and other plants designated by the Minister of the Environment may not be collected or damaged in park special areas without permission. Designated-plant lists are park-specific and revised over time.
veto_law_jp_keihou_235_text: Taking another person's property can constitute theft. Removing a tree without a lawful title is treated as taking property.
veto_law_jp_minpo_206_text: Ownership includes the right to use, profit from, and dispose of a thing within the limits of laws and regulations. Collecting plants on land you do not own is not authorized by this article.
veto_law_jp_minpo_207_text: Ownership of land extends above and below the surface within legal limits — trees and soil on the land belong to the landowner. Uprooting without a lawful title is not permitted.
veto_law_jp_natural_parks_text: In special areas of national or quasi-national parks, listed acts (including collecting or damaging designated plants) require permission from the Minister of the Environment or the prefectural governor. Outside a national park does not mean collecting is free.
veto_law_jp_natural_parks_title: Natural Parks Act — special areas / special protection zones
veto_law_jp_rinya_text: Activities in national forests require the competent Forestry Agency / forest office authority. Collecting trees is not assumed lawful.
veto_law_jp_shinrin_text: Forest operations including felling are regulated. National and privately managed forests are not a free-for-all for transplanting trees.
veto_law_jp_species_conservation_text: Collecting, capturing, killing, or damaging live individuals of nationally rare species is prohibited except under limited statutory exceptions or Minister permission. Prefectural lists may add further restrictions.
veto_law_jp_species_conservation_title: Endangered Species Act — nationally rare species
veto_law_property_heading: A. Property law (Civil Code & Penal Code)
veto_mairie_contact: Contact {name} with parcel {parcel} about the access-authorisation process.
veto_mairie_loading: Looking up town hall contact details…
veto_mairie_unavailable: Town hall contact unavailable — search for "town hall of {commune}".
veto_property_intro: In France, the tree belongs to the owner of the land where it germinated.
veto_property_intro_au: In Australia, collecting plants in CAPAD-listed protected areas needs authorisation. Outside CAPAD, verify private or other Crown tenure — Yamadori does not map all land.
veto_property_intro_ca: In Canada, legality depends on the province and land type (private, Crown, park…). Yamadori detects protected areas via CPCAD — not all Crown land.
veto_property_intro_generic: The tree generally belongs to whoever holds rights over the land where it germinated — access and collection authorisation is required.
veto_property_intro_jp: In Japan, Nominatim locality is not a verified parcel title. Yamadori can scan national-park zones from onboard data — 国有林 and private land still need separate checks.
veto_property_intro_nz: In New Zealand, collecting plants on DOC public conservation land needs authorisation. Outside DOC PCL, verify private / Māori / other Crown tenure — Yamadori does not map all land.
veto_property_intro_us: In the U.S., legality depends on the landowner and land type (private, BLM, National Forest, park…). Yamadori detects public tenure via PAD-US — not private parcels.
veto_scan_cached: Result from local cache (area already scanned or offline mode).
veto_scan_clear: No national park or national nature reserve detected at this GPS point.
veto_scan_offline_miss: Offline and no cache for this point — reconnect to scan protected areas, or check manually.
veto_scan_partial_coverage: Partial protected-area coverage for this country: no hit does not mean the area is unrestricted.
veto_species_examples_body: Order of 20 January 1982 (non-exhaustive): Dwarf birch (Betula nana), Salzmann pine (Pinus nigra subsp. salzmannii), some wild willows (Salix lapponum, S. repens…), Daphne species.
veto_species_examples_body_at: Land Artenschutz (not federal): yew (Taxus baccata) and mezereon (Daphne mezereum) are widely listed — treat as veto and check your Bundesland ordinance. Caution: holly, mountain pine, juniper. Forest access (ForstG § 33) ≠ collection; felling may need approval (ForstG § 85). Check BMLUK / Landesforst.
veto_species_examples_body_au: Landowner consent required on private land. EPBC veto (national): Wollemi pine (Wollemia nobilis). Caution: Banksia spp., waratah, Huon pine, celery-top pine. In CAPAD reserves, Parks Australia or state/territory park permits are usually required and rarely granted for yamadori. Check ALA, EPBC lists, and your state parks agency.
veto_species_examples_body_be: Protection is mostly regional (Flanders Soortenbesluit, Wallonia nature law, Brussels ordinance). Yamadori examples: juniper (Juniperus communis), royal fern (Osmunda regalis), mezereon (Daphne mezereum), yew (Taxus baccata), holly (Ilex aquifolium). Non-exhaustive — check Waarnemingen.be / your region.
veto_species_examples_body_ca: Landowner consent required on private land. SARA veto (national): American chestnut, butternut, eastern flowering dogwood, red mulberry, whitebark pine. Caution: limber pine, cherry birch, Kentucky coffee-tree. On Crown land, provincial or territorial authorization is usually required even for non-listed trees. Check the SARA registry and your province or territory.
veto_species_examples_body_ch: Protection is mostly cantonal (Info Flora). Yamadori examples: mezereon (Daphne mezereum — often fully protected), yew (Taxus baccata), holly (Ilex aquifolium), dwarf birch (Betula nana). Non-exhaustive — check Info Flora / your canton.
veto_species_examples_body_de: National protection via BArtSchV Annex 1 (wild populations). Yamadori examples: yew (Taxus baccata), holly (Ilex aquifolium), mezereon (Daphne spp.), dwarf birch (Betula nana), royal fern (Osmunda regalis), box (Buxus sempervirens). Non-exhaustive — check FloraWeb / your Land.
veto_species_examples_body_dk: Landowner consent required — public access ≠ digging up living trees. Nationally fredet (veto): royal fern / Kongebregne (Osmunda). Caution: yew / Taks, holly / Kristtorn, juniper / Ene. Check Arter.dk, §3 / Natura 2000, Naturstyrelsen / kommune.
veto_species_examples_body_es: Protection is mostly regional (CCAA); LESRPE/CEEA covers the national level. Yamadori examples: Spanish fir (Abies pinsapo — Andalusia), yew (Taxus baccata — regional catalogues), holly (Ilex aquifolium). Non-exhaustive — check Anthos / your CCAA.
veto_species_examples_body_fi: Landowner consent required — jokaisenoikeudet ≠ digging up living trees. Nationally rauhoitettu (veto): yew / Marjakuusi (Taxus), mezereon / Lehtonäsiä (Daphne). Caution: juniper / Kataja. Check Laji.fi, Metsähallitus permits, and your kunta.
veto_species_examples_body_gb: Schedule 8 (WCA 1981) national veto examples: wild cotoneaster (Cotoneaster integerrimus), Plymouth pear (Pyrus cordata). Caution (not Schedule 8): yew, holly, juniper, mezereon. Check Forestry Commission / NatureScot / NRW / DAERA for your nation — landowner consent and felling rules still apply.
veto_species_examples_body_ie: Landowner consent required. Flora Protection Order (veto): tea-leaved willow (Salix phylicifolia), English whitebeam (Sorbus anglica). Caution: yew, holly, juniper — owner + SAC/SPA/NHA. Check NPWS FPO, Coillte, and your local authority.
veto_species_examples_body_it: Protection is mostly regional / parks (Natura 2000, Law 394/91). Yamadori examples: Sicilian fir (Abies nebrodensis), Bosnian pine (Pinus heldreichii — Pollino), yew (Taxus baccata). Non-exhaustive — check FlorItaly / your regione.
veto_species_examples_body_jp: Landowner consent required on private land. Caution (non-exhaustive): Japanese black pine (クロマツ), red pine (アカマツ), maple (モミジ). Park 指定植物 lists and 種の保存法 rare species can forbid collection. Check MOE and your prefecture — a national form is not a permit.
veto_species_examples_body_nl: Omgevingswet zorgplicht applies to wild plants; few woody yamadori taxa remain nationally listed. Caution: juniper (Rode Lijst / H5130 habitats), yew, holly, royal fern. Forest access ≠ collection; felling outside the wooded contour may need a provincial kapmelding (Bal). Check RVO / Omgevingsloket / your provincie.
veto_species_examples_body_no: Allemannsretten ≠ digging up living trees — landowner consent required. Caution (rødliste / vernområder): yew / barlind (Taxus), holly / kristtorn (Ilex), juniper / einer. Check Artsdatabanken, vernforskrift, and Statsforvalteren.
veto_species_examples_body_nz: Landowner consent required on private land. Veto: kauri (Agathis australis) — dieback / high protection. Caution: pōhutukawa, rātā, tōtara, rimu, miro, kahikatea; mountain beech regional. On DOC public conservation land, Form 10 authorisation is usually required. Whenua Rahui / iwi areas need governing consent. Check NZPCN, NZTCS, and DOC.
veto_species_examples_body_pt: National cork/holm oak cutting rules (DL 169/2001). Yamadori examples: cork oak (Quercus suber), holm oak (Quercus rotundifolia), yew (Taxus baccata), holly (Ilex aquifolium). Madeira/Azores have regional regimes — check Flora-On / ICNF / IFCN / SRAAC.
veto_species_examples_body_se: Allemansrätten ≠ digging up living trees — landowner consent required. County-fridlysta (veto): yew / Idegran (Taxus) and mezereon / Tibast (Daphne) in certain län. Caution: holly, juniper, twinflower. Check Artfakta / Länsstyrelsen / Skogsstyrelsen.
veto_species_examples_body_us: Landowner consent required on private land. ESA veto (national): Florida torreya, whitebark pine (Threatened, 4(d)). Regional veto: Torrey pine (California). Caution: bristlecone, redwood, giant sequoia. On USFS/BLM, Special Forest Products / BLM permits are usually required even for non-listed trees. Check ECOS, your Ranger District / BLM office, and state DNR.

veto_species_inpn_body: Before any collection, check on the official INPN (MNHN) database that the species is not protected by a national or regional order. A red "Protected species" badge means collection is a criminal offence, even with owner consent.
veto_species_regional_generic: Over 400 species are nationally protected, and hundreds more regionally. Always check INPN — do not rely on a fixed in-app list.
veto_species_regional_pdl: Pays de la Loire region detected (GPS): subject to the 25 January 1993 order. Wetlands, heathland and coastal dunes (Gâvre, Loire hillsides, marshes) have many strictly protected species.
veto_tenure_forbidden_warn: Warning: tenure indicator is “forbidden”. This does not hard-block confirmation — verify with the competent authority before any collection.
veto_zone_appb_hint: Strict habitat protection — check prefectural orders.
veto_zone_appb_manual: No national coverage — check prefectural orders for your department.
veto_zone_capad_conservation_hint: Agency permit required — rarely granted for yamadori.
veto_zone_doc_conservation_hint: DOC permit required — rarely granted for yamadori.
veto_zone_jp_unsupported_hint: Onboard park polygons could not be loaded. Verify national parks, prefectural parks, and 国有林 yourself before collecting.
veto_zone_ksj_national_park_hint: Permit required under the Natural Parks Act — collecting is not free.
veto_zone_ksj_prefectural_park_hint: Prefectural rules apply — verify before collecting.
veto_zone_ksj_special_zone_hint: 特別地域 / 特別保護地区 — collecting designated plants without a permit is prohibited.
veto_zone_natura_hint: Subject to impact assessment or specific prefectural order.
veto_zone_outside_capad_hint: May be private or other Crown — verify before collecting.
veto_zone_outside_ksj_hint: May still be 国有林 or private land — verify before collecting.
veto_zone_outside_pcl_hint: May be private, Māori, or other Crown — verify before collecting.
veto_zone_pnr_hint: Park charter — check local rules before any collection.
veto_zone_rnr_regional_hint: Regional, Corsican or hunting reserves — constraints vary by order.
veto_zone_status_certain: Zone detected at your GPS position.
veto_zone_status_potential: Your cadastral parcel may overlap this zone.
veto_zone_whenua_rahui_hint: No collecting without the governing authority.
veto_zone_znieff_hint: Ecological interest zone — check local constraints.
visit_placeholder: E.g. Root ring prep, structural pruning… (optional if photo or voice note)
